categories.main_business_segments: Greentown Service Group Co. Ltd. operates primarily in four business segments: property services, community living services, consulting services, and technology services. Property services include security, cleaning, gardening, and maintenance for managed properties. Community living services provide daily necessities, lifestyle products, and cultural and educational services to residents. Consulting services support real estate developers and property management companies throughout the property lifecycle, while technology services focus on digitalization and smart property solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group leverages digital platforms and smart hardware to deliver integrated technology services, including intelligent property management systems, smart community platforms, and digital solutions for government and property enterprises. They employ digital empowerment and precise operational models such as 'one project one model' to enhance efficiency. Technologies like AI-powered glasses, cleaning and customer service robots, and brain-computer interface solutions are piloted to innovate service delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are property owners, residents, real estate developers, and local property management companies across China. The Group serves high-end residential, government public construction, commercial office buildings, and urban complexes. Their consulting and technology services target real estate developers, property management companies, and government clients. Community living services cater to residents’ daily and lifestyle needs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates extensively across China, managing properties in 202 cities spanning 31 provinces, direct-controlled municipalities, and autonomous regions. Key regional focuses include Hangzhou, Ningbo, the Yangtze River Delta (excluding Hangzhou and Ningbo), the Bohai Economic Rim, and the Pearl River Delta. The headquarters is in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, with a principal place of business in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: Greentown Service Group operates primarily in the downstream segment of the real estate supply chain, providing property management and related lifestyle services directly to property owners and residents. It also offers consulting services to upstream real estate developers and midstream property management companies. The Group integrates technology services to support digital transformation within the property management ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group’s strategic focus is on high-quality development, management refinement, and technological empowerment. It emphasizes digital transformation through smart property and community platforms, AI applications, and integrated service models. The Group pursues innovation in service delivery, operational efficiency, and ecosystem integration, including partnerships with technology firms like Ant Group and DingTalk. Future R&D aims to enhance product standardization, replication, and customer structure optimization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through service fees charged to residents, property owners, and real estate developers for property management, community living services, consulting, and technology services. The property services segment, accounting for about 66.9% of revenue, charges management fees based on managed gross floor area. Consulting and technology services generate revenue through project-based and subscription-like contracts. Community living services derive income from sales of daily necessities and lifestyle products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The Group is positioned as a leading happy living service provider in China with a strong presence in first- and second-tier cities. It is recognized among the top property management and urban service enterprises in China, receiving multiple industry awards. The Group differentiates itself through integrated service offerings, technological innovation, and a focus on quality and customer satisfaction. Major competitors are other large property management firms and urban service providers in China.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 December 2024, the Group reported revenue of approximately RMB18.53 billion, representing a 6.5% year-on-year growth. Net profit attributable to equity shareholders was RMB785.1 million, up 29.7% year-on-year. The managed gross floor area reached 509 million sq.m., a 13.5% increase from 2023. The Group maintains a strong cash position with RMB4.85 billion in cash and equivalents and a net cash position. The employee base grew to 48,423, reflecting business expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Greentown Service Group emphasizes high-quality, customer-oriented services that enhance residents’ lifestyles across the full life cycle of real estate. Its value proposition lies in integrating property management with community living, consulting, and technology services to create a comprehensive 'property + lifestyle' ecosystem. The Group leverages technology to improve efficiency and service innovation, offering intelligent, inclusive, and affordable solutions. Its focus on cultural integration, service quality, and digital empowerment differentiates it from competitors.
